reason: Raw GBIF record counts can overweight intensively sampled regions. Preserve the frozen record-weighted primary analysis, but require a spatially thinned realm-assignment sensitivity before interpreting broad realm generality.

sensitivity.grid: 1 degree longitude x 1 degree latitude cells in EPSG:4326
sensitivity.realm_cell_count: number of unique occupied 1-degree cells assigned to each Holt realm
sensitivity.cell_primary_realm: realm with the largest unique occupied-cell count; exact ties are TIE
sensitivity.cell_primary_realm_share: largest realm cell count divided by total unique realm-assigned cells

interpretation_rule: A strong claim of realm-general portfolio architecture should not depend on record-weighted versus 1-degree-cell-weighted primary-realm assignment; disagreements are reported rather than resolved by choosing the more favorable scheme.
